steps.say: Let's start with one positive point charge. We call its charge capital Q.

subtitles.uz: Bitta musbat nuqtaviy zaryaddan boshlaymiz. Uning zaryadini katta Q deb belgilaymiz.

steps.say: A positive charge sends electric field lines straight out in every direction, like spokes on a wheel. Here are twelve of them.

subtitles.uz: Musbat zaryad elektr maydon chiziqlarini g'ildirak kegaylari kabi hamma tomonga to'g'ri chiqaradi. Mana ulardan o'n ikkitasi.

steps.say: Now imagine a closed bubble around the charge. It is not real, just a tool. We call it a Gaussian surface.

subtitles.uz: Endi zaryad atrofida yopiq pufakni tasavvur qiling. U haqiqiy emas, faqat vosita. Uni Gauss sirti deymiz.

steps.say: Electric flux measures how much field pokes through a surface. We write it as phi. Here, twelve lines cross the bubble, so the flux is twelve lines' worth.

subtitles.uz: Elektr oqimi sirtdan qancha maydon o'tishini ko'rsatadi. Uni fi (Φ) bilan belgilaymiz. Bu yerda pufakdan o'n ikkita chiziq o'tadi, demak oqim o'n ikki chiziqqa teng.

steps.say: Here is a bigger bubble around the same charge. Your turn: what happens to the flux through it?

subtitles.uz: Mana shu zaryad atrofida kattaroq pufak. Navbat sizda: undan o'tadigan oqim qanday o'zgaradi?

checkpoint.question: The bigger surface surrounds the same charge. The flux through it...
checkpoint.hint: Count the lines that cross the bigger bubble.
checkpoint.reexplain_hint: Use the count-the-lines picture again: every line that crosses the small bubble also crosses the big one.

steps.say: Same lines, same flux. Flux depends only on the charge inside: phi equals Q over epsilon zero. For three nanocoulombs, that is about 339 newton meters squared per coulomb.

subtitles.uz: Chiziqlar bir xil, oqim ham bir xil. Oqim faqat ichkaridagi zaryadga bog'liq: fi Q ni epsilon nolga bo'linganiga teng. Uch nanokulon uchun bu taxminan 339 N·m²/C.

steps.say: To sum up: flux counts field lines through a closed surface. Any closed surface around the same charge gives the same flux, Q over epsilon zero.

subtitles.uz: Xulosa: oqim yopiq sirtdan o'tgan maydon chiziqlarini sanaydi. Shu zaryad atrofidagi har qanday yopiq sirt bir xil oqim beradi: Q ni epsilon nolga bo'lingani.

draw.text: any closed surface around Q → same Φ
